en: The image shows an old black-and-white postcard featuring a large railway station building with people standing outside. The building has signs that read 'KARLOVAROS-KARLOVAC' and the captions 'Karlovac' and 'Kolodvor' (Croatian for 'station'). The reverse side contains handwritten correspondence, a postage stamp from the Austro-Hungarian era labeled 'MAGYAR KIR. POSTA,' and printed text in Croatian. The postcard is addressed to Zagreb.
